personal.philosophyOfCare: Pelvic pain is real, and I believe you when you describe it. We work together on a plan, and we decide together what the next step is.
personal.whyMedicine: I spent my early twenties being told my own pain was normal. I wanted to be the doctor I needed then.
personal.professionalPurpose: I want the years between first symptom and diagnosis to be shorter for the next person than they were for me.
personal.communicationApproach: I draw the anatomy, use plain language and send you home with a written plan.
personal.livedExperience: I live with endometriosis and had surgery for it twice.
hobbies: Ocean swimming at Burleigh before work
personal.outsideMedicine: Weekends are the dog, the ocean and my sister's kids.
